dataorigin-trade-show-prep-skill-trade-s.description: Prepare, work and follow up a B2B trade show for an exhibitor or a visiting sales team. Builds a dated plan from 8 weeks before the fair, drafts meeting requests for the user's own accounts (email and LinkedIn), writes a booth qualification guide with a note template, and drafts a post-show follow-up sequence with cost per lead and ROI. Use when the user says "prepare our trade show", "we are exhibiting at", "we are visiting a fair", "meeting requests for the show", "booth qualification", "trade show follow-up", "post-show emails" or asks for help before, during or after a B2B fair or…
